rows.text: when bit 0x1000 of dword `rcx+0x3E8` is set, for each of the three qwords from `0209CC18` up to (not including) `0209CC30` calls the function at `002A84F0` + 0x33 with `rcx` = that qword and then stores 0 to it; when the bit is clear it returns without work

notes: 002A84F0: the loop bound is a pointer compare (jl) of an 8-byte stride from 0209CC18 against 0209CC30, i.e. three qwords; the callee is called even for a null qword.
